competitorWins: The Bellingcat Toolkit is the gold standard for open-source investigation methodology: hundreds of tools curated from 10+ years of real investigative work (MH17, Syria, Ukraine), with in-depth usage guides, use cases, and ethical guidance that no aggregator can replace. As a free, community-maintained knowledge base, it teaches you how to investigate — satellite imagery verification, geolocation, flight tracking, archiving — rather than doing it for you. WorldEye is a data window, not a methodology; anyone serious about OSINT craft should be learning from Bellingcat's resources regardless of what dashboard they watch.
description: The Bellingcat Toolkit (Online Investigation Toolkit 2.0, hosted on GitBook) is Bellingcat's free, community-maintained directory of hundreds of curated OSINT tools organized by category — satellite imagery, flight tracking (ADS-B Exchange, FlightAware), maritime (Equasis), social media, archiving — with usage notes and guides from a decade of award-winning open-source investigations. It's a toolbox library, not a platform: WorldEye, by contrast, is one live integrated dashboard (3D globe, flights, ships, ~76,000 cameras, weather) that's free to use instantly.

name: Bellingcat Toolkit
pricing: Free — the toolkit itself is a freely accessible, community-maintained directory with no account or payment required. (Individual tools it lists range from free to freemium to paid; Bellingcat also sells training separately.)
seoDescription: WorldEye vs Bellingcat Toolkit: free live 3D planet monitoring vs the free curated OSINT tool directory. What each does and which fits your need.
seoTitle: WorldEye vs Bellingcat Toolkit (2026): Live Globe vs Free OSINT Tool Directory
tagline: Bellingcat's free, community-maintained directory of hundreds of curated OSINT tools with guides, from the award-winning investigative journalism collective.
verdictCompetitor: Choose the Bellingcat Toolkit if you want to learn the craft of open-source investigation — curated tools, methodology guides, and the community's accumulated knowledge, all free and built on real casework.
verdictWorldEye: Choose WorldEye if you want a live, integrated world view for free — flights, ships, cameras, weather, and events on one interactive 3D globe with no setup, no learning curve, and no signup.
whyWorldEye: WorldEye is live data, not a directory: one dashboard streams flights, vessels, earthquakes, wildfires, and ~76,000 public cameras in real time.
Free with no signup — open worldeye.app and the interactive 3D globe is immediately usable.
Complements the Bellingcat Toolkit: use the toolkit to learn investigative technique, then pivot to WorldEye for live visual monitoring of a location, flight path, or event.
Pro (from $3.99/week) adds an AI analyst assistant, OSINT toolkit (Nmap, DNS, WHOIS, SSL), premium intel feeds, and high-res satellite imagery in one subscription.
Mobile-friendly — the whole live planet fits in a browser on your phone.
